name: North Korea

nso.name: Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) of the DPR Korea
nso.note: No public website is known to me; the census reports circulate through UNFPA and the UN Statistics Division.

latest_census.notes: DPR Korea 2008 Population Census, enumerated 1-15 October 2008 with UNFPA technical support; 'National Report' published 2009 by the CBS, Pyongyang, and circulated by UNFPA/UNSD. The questionnaire covered relationship to head, sex, age, marital status, education, economic activity and occupation, fertility, migration and housing -- no religion, ethnicity or language item; the state counts its population as ethnically homogeneous and does not enumerate religion, and the 1993 census likewise had none. A follow-up census was planned for October 2018 with UNFPA support; I have no knowledge of its results being published. This is a C: a not_collected declaration for all three fields with the 2008 questionnaire and report table list as evidence.

already_in_map: Nothing subnational; the national record is Factbook free text for all three fields.

subnational_sources.title: DPR Korea 2008 Population Census -- National Report (CBS, 2009): population by province and by county/city/district, with age, sex, education, economic activity and housing tables
subnational_sources.publisher: Central Bureau of Statistics, DPRK (distributed by UNFPA; a copy is held by the UN Statistics Division)
subnational_sources.matches_boundary_level: admin1 (11 shapes vs the report's first-level units) and admin2 (179 shapes vs roughly 200 counties/cities) -- denominators and names only; no religion, ethnicity or language tables exist in it
subnational_sources.confidence: high that the report exists; high that it carries none of the three fields
subnational_sources.evidence: Recalled table of contents; the census is the only subnational statistical publication from the DPRK in decades and its contents are well documented in the demographic literature.

secondary_routes.hdx: OCHA COD population tables for PRK derive from the 2008 census (denominators only); the runner searches HDX itself.
secondary_routes.us_census_bureau: Not in the subnational series as recorded.

tier_reason: The only census (2008) asked none of religion, ethnicity or language, and no other statistical publication does; the right output is a not_collected declaration at every level citing the 2008 census questionnaire.
recommended_action: Declare religion, ethnicity and language not_collected for PRK at admin1 and admin2 (and note the national record is estimate/free text), citing the 2008 Population Census National Report's table list. Do not spend a runner on it; the 2008 report is useful only as a denominator if the map ever needs one.
not_found: any DPRK publication of religion, ethnicity or language at any level
summary: North Korea's only modern census, the UNFPA-supported 2008 Population Census, asked nothing about religion, ethnicity or language, and the state publishes no other subnational statistics; the 2009 National Report tabulates population, age, sex, education, work and housing by province and county. The correct record is a not_collected declaration for all three fields at both levels with the 2008 questionnaire as evidence. No statistical-office website is known.
